title: Figure 13: Object Sightings by Duration of Sighting with Evaluation Distribution
description: A vertical stacked bar on the left divides sightings into duration groups, from "5 sec or less" (13.0%) through "Over 30 min" (7.8%) to "Not stated" (24.9%). Dashed lines connect each group to a horizontal 0–100 percent bar on the right that shows its evaluation breakdown (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown); the x-axis is "Evaluations in Per Cent". Caption: "FIGURE 13 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY DURATION OF SIGHTING WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH DURATION GROUP"; drawing A-7491.
